name: SentinelOps Runtime and GovCloud Policy-as-Code
framework: NIST AI RMF / FedRAMP-aligned readiness controls (not authorized)

rules.label: Gate decisions require reviewer identity, reviewer role, and explicit state.
rules.remediation: Resolve the reviewer from trusted auth context before mutating the gate.

rules.label: Gate decision must remain linked to run, trace, and approval gate identifiers.
rules.remediation: Reject decisions that cannot be tied to the current run trace and gate ID.

rules.label: Controlled pilot approval requires complete action-group evidence.
rules.remediation: Attach scoped service account, egress allowlist, rollback, and audit-retention evidence before approval.

rules.label: Persisted gate state must match the reviewer decision.
rules.remediation: Abort the transition when the persisted gate state diverges from the reviewer decision.

rules.label: ECS tasks must run in private networking without public IP assignment.
rules.remediation: Keep ECS service network configuration on private subnets with assign_public_ip set to false.

rules.label: Pilot load balancer must be internal only.
rules.remediation: Keep the application load balancer internal and restrict ingress to enterprise CIDRs.

rules.label: AWS service access must use private VPC endpoints.
rules.remediation: Route S3, DynamoDB, ECR, logs, secrets, and SSM access through VPC endpoints.

rules.label: Evidence storage and approval ledger must be encrypted and recoverable.
rules.remediation: Keep KMS encryption, S3 versioning, and DynamoDB point-in-time recovery enabled.

rules.label: Container runtime should minimize mutation and remote shell access.
rules.remediation: Keep the root filesystem read-only and ECS execute-command disabled for the pilot.
